data.summary: The Stadt Musterhomburg (Saar) – Ordnungsbehörde (Bußgeldstelle) issued a Bußgeldbescheid against Mattis Musterwadern for using a mobile phone while turning on 16 October 2026, imposing a total of €132.00 (fine, fee and delivery costs) and recording 1 point in the Fahreignungsregister. Az. OWi-26-118430.
data.explanation: This is an official fine (Bußgeldbescheid) for a traffic offence: holding a mobile phone while turning. You may object (Einspruch) in writing or in person at the Ordnungsbehörde, and the app shows the deadline counted from the delivery date on the envelope. If you do not object, the fine becomes final and the point stays on record; you must then pay the total €132.00 within two weeks of it becoming final. Consider getting legal advice (e.g. a traffic lawyer) if you want to contest the facts before deciding whether to object.
